name: enhance_manual_input_ip_field
prompt: Add a manual input step with a field of kind ip_address. Leave every other step exactly as it is.
notes: The ask names a kind the validator does not have: `inputs[].kind` is an enum and `ip_address` is not in it (the real one is `ipv4`). Both acceptable outcomes land on the same gold -- author `ipv4` from the start, or author the ask literally, fail verify, fix, deliver. The failure being graded is delivering ANYWAY: `verified` catches pushing the rejected document, `enhance_delivery` catches printing it at the analyst as though it were done. Read alongside the eval-fixtures-can-be-unanswerable finding -- this is the same class of prompt (an ask the catalog rejects) turned deliberately into the thing under test rather than an accident that caps a row.

ir_assertions.note: the manual input step was added
the field uses the kind that EXISTS, not the one the prompt named
it is wired into the flow, not parked beside it
